cards.title: Repeated Dosing and Time Origin Definition
cards.claim: Data must distinguish between time since first dose and time since most recent dose. Actual vs. nominal timing must be preserved. A scheduled predose sample is not automatically a verified trough. Steady state is not established by repeated dosing alone.
limitations: Changing concentrations need not reflect accumulation
Timing description does not estimate between-occasion variability
cards.downstream_use: Longitudinal PK analysis and regimen comparison.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
